## Profit and Loss

Set `fromMonth` and `toMonth`. `closes` queries the Month Close cards in that range and `accounts` loads the chart. `rows` (`StatementRow`, an internal output shape) carries each income, cost-of-goods-sold and expense account's net on its normal side. Computed totals: `incomeMinor`, `cogsMinor`, `expenseMinor`, `grossProfitMinor` (income less cost of goods sold) and `netIncomeMinor` (gross profit less expenses).

The page shows a summary with gross margin, then one statement with each section's lines and subtotal, gross profit and net income. Each account row expands to its amount per month, read from the same closed months.

```ts
import { ProfitAndLoss } from '@cardstack/catalog/cards/accounting/ledger-close';
```

`view` (a Report View) reads it on the cash basis, by month, quarter, class, or customer or vendor, and against the previous period or year.

### Non-goals
No operations. No budget columns, and no location split.

### Example
`Reports/pnl-2026-q1`, January through March 2026.
